description.en:
Operator Kroos the Keen Glint has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude for maintaining distance whilst conducting suppressive fire against the enemy.
The Field Operations Department has thus passed the following resolution:
This operator shall be appointed a Sniper Operator during field operations to exercise Marksman responsibilities.
In witness whereof,
This badge is hereby conferred upon the above named.
description.zh:
干员寒芒克洛丝擅长保持距离对敌人进行火力压制
根据外勤部门决议
在外勤任务中划分为狙击干员，行使速射手职责
特别颁发此证章
以兹证明

description.en:
I got lectured by the instructors at the Training Room. Kroos kept staring at me the whole time after I messed up, and she called for me come with her after we wrapped up. I thought she was going to chew me out too, but instead she gave me some cake.
She must've seen how down I was feeling. But I did mess up, that's a fact. I saw a teammate ahead to my left who hadn't noticed the danger behind him, so I went to go help him. I acted without warning, and didn't expect to get hit by a training bolt. I caused the mission to fail right then and there. The instructors said no one should be making such a basic mistake. I was so embarrassed.
'Shh. This is from my secret stash~'
I nodded and gave a bite. It was sweet and creamy, with roasted apple slices on top, and—wrapped chocolates inside?!
'I was gonna put something in there that'd break your teeth right off, but seeing how you were on the verge of tears, I switched it for chocolate, see?'
Kroos unwrapped one and popped it into her mouth, then unwrapped another for me. We sat on the bench next to the door to the Training Room, and she told me all sorts of things. How she'd made her own mistakes—ones just like mine today—how she'd gotten into massive arguments with her teammates over a disagreement in the field, how she had all these pranks of hers, and how she'd remodeled her crossbow.
And at the very end, I'd finished the cake, and put the chocolate in my bag. Kroos patted me on the head and said, 'You're going to remember today's lesson, aren't you?'
'I just thought, if I'd seen it but didn't help, I'd regret it...'
She gave me a serious look. 'If something does happen for real, regret'll just be part and parcel. Training helps us not make the same mistakes in real combat.' She tossed a toy at me, some kind of prank thing again. 'Use this to give that other operator of yours a fright!'
'But don't tell anyone I've been stashing the sweet stuff again!'
A long while later, I'd finally become a formal operator, and I made the correct decision in a crisis. Nobody was even hurt. In a rush of glee, I couldn't help but think of that day, of Kroos's cake and the things she told me.
I sought her out after I returned to the landship, and once she'd finished taking in my combat report, she showed me something. It was a thick, dense file, with line after line of planned adjustments for the training equipment's trigger timing, and how every Reserve Operator would respond. All in her handwriting.
'Less regrets this way,' she laughed. 'You did great.'
description.zh:
我在训练室被教官批评了，犯错以后克洛丝前辈一直在看我，还在结束后叫我跟着她过去。我原本以为她也要批评我，没想到她给了我一块蛋糕。
前辈应该也是看出了我心情不好吧。但我确实做错了。我当时看到左前方的队友没发现背后的危险，想去帮他一把，没有报告就行动了，却没想到自己被训练用箭射中，害得任务直接失败。教官说这种低级的失误不应该出现在任何一个人的身上，好丢脸。
“悄悄地，这可是我私藏的哦~”
我点点头，咬下一口，奶油甜甜的，上面还放了烘烤过的苹果片，里面是——一颗一颗包装好的巧克力？！
“本来里面放的可是能把你牙硌掉的东西，但看你都快要哭出来了，我就换成了巧克力哦~”
克洛丝前辈剥开一个放在嘴里，给我也剥了一个。我们坐在训练室门口的长凳上，她给我讲了很多事。有她自己过往的失误——和我今天犯的一模一样，有她在战场上和队友因为意见不同而大吵一架，还有她的恶作剧，和她的那把被改造过的弩。
说到最后，我吃完了蛋糕，把巧克力放进口袋。克洛丝前辈拍了拍我的头，“你一定会记住今天的教训，是不是？”
“我只是觉得自己看到了，却没有帮忙，可能会后悔……”
前辈认真地看着我的眼睛，“如果事情真的发生了，遗憾也是无法避免的，训练就是让你们能在实战中不要犯同样的错误。”她向我丢来一个小玩意儿，看起来也是恶作剧的道具，“拿这个也去吓吓你前面那个干员！”
“不过，别告诉其他人我又藏了甜食哦~”
许久之后，我终于成为了正式干员，在一次危机中，我做出了正确的判断，甚至没有人受伤。在劫后余生的欣喜里，我不由得想起那一天，克洛丝前辈的蛋糕和她给我说的那些事。
在返回本舰后我找到了前辈，她听完了我的作战报告，给我看了一样东西。那是厚厚一沓文件，里面列满了训练室每个训练用装置的触发时间调整方案和每个预备干员可能会做出的反应，全是前辈的笔迹。
“这样就能少些遗憾了。”克洛丝前辈笑了笑，“你做得很好。”
